name: Kopala, Warden of Waves
oracle_text:
Spells your opponents cast that target a Merfolk you control cost {2} more to cast.
Abilities your opponents activate that target a Merfolk you control cost {2} more to activate.
blocked_sentences: Abilities your opponents activate that target a Merfolk you control cost {2} more to activate.

needs.what: a static that makes activated abilities cost more generic mana to activate, keyed on the activating player (activated_by: opponent) and on the activation's chosen targets (targeting: {subtypes: [Merfolk], controller: you}); the mirror of ability_cost_reduction in the way spell_cost_increase mirrors spell_cost_reduction, with the targeting clause read meanly (tax left out) at the pre-target gate and charged exactly per target tuple
needs.why_existing_wont_do: ability_cost_reduction has activated_by, affects_abilities {any} and targeting, but it only subtracts a discount and reads its targeting clause generously at the gate (as though it applied), which is the wrong convention for a tax; a negative amount would be an unsanctioned hack. spell_cost_increase covers the first sentence (Kasmina's shape) but is read only on the cast path, never for activations
